Part I

Vienna

01Museum Booster, January 2026

Museum Connections, Paris

Preparation for Museum Booster’s stand at Museum Connections, the museum trade fair in Paris: the messaging, the printed materials and the launch assets the Museum Booster Academy needed for its first public appearance.

The concept on the stand is called Don’t Panic. Museum leaders work under shrinking budgets and public scrutiny, and most leadership programmes sell them urgency. This one does the opposite: reassurance first, and four two-day workshops in Vienna, 25 seats each, for those who want to go further.

The fair ran for three days in January; the stand travelled with sticker sheets and yellow t-shirts.

02Vienna, 2026

What Matters Platform

Registration pages, newsletters and visuals for two public evenings of a design editorial community. Future Bridge is the first event of the What Matters Platform series.

For guests who had been at Milan Design Week, the invitations went out as postcard-style emails (“From Milan, with notes”) rather than a newsletter blast. On the evenings themselves I coordinated on site and photographed the room.

The posters also ran as short motion loops, which I generated with AI video tools from the print designs. Generative AI is part of my normal toolkit for image and video work.

Client projects from the Fontys programme.

04Lumosa, 2025

Sustainability You Can Trust

A positioning and communication plan for an energy-tech company ahead of its 2025 trade fairs. The buyers, mostly municipalities in Noord-Brabant, wanted technical proof rather than warm storytelling, so the plan kept the warmth and added the evidence. I presented it to the client, who singled out the slogan.

05Living Lab 040, Eindhoven

The Conscious Toolkit

Living Lab 040 tests sustainable housing on an urban site in Eindhoven, and most of its research sat in dense reports. The toolkit turns that research into AutoCAD templates and Revit models professionals can open in their own software. The site is live.
